reddit.title: Improving Audio Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant updates to how our colony's music plays, ensuring a smoother experience without those jarring cuts. With a new crossfade feature, the transition between day, night, and combat music feels seamless. Check out the details in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

posts: Exciting news! We've enhanced the audio experience in Provincia by implementing a smooth crossfade for our music beds. This means no more abrupt cuts when transitioning between day and night. Learn more about these updates here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

We've been working hard to improve the audio in Provincia. Our latest update introduces a long equal-power crossfade for music transitions, making your gameplay experience even better. steam.title: Audio Enhancements in Provincia
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce improvements to the audio experience in Provincia! Our new crossfade feature for music beds ensures smooth transitions between day, night, and combat themes. Say goodbye to sudden cuts and hello to a more immersive gameplay experience. Learn more about these updates in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
